name: flowchart-creator
description: Create clear, editable flowcharts and process diagrams from prose, requirements, or code.

interface.shortDescription: Turn ideas and processes into clear flowcharts.
interface.longDescription: Creates structured flowcharts, decision trees, workflow diagrams, and process maps. It defaults to editable Mermaid source and can adapt the format to Graphviz, ASCII, SVG, or PNG when requested and supported.
defaultPrompt: Turn this process into a flowchart.
Create a decision tree from these rules.
Diagram the control flow in this code.
